name: Afor Foundation Scholarship Programme
description: An annual scholarship programme founded by Prof. Dr. Roland Teboh Forbang, a son of Guneku and Associate Professor and Medical Director at Hackensack Meridian Health Network in New Jersey. The programme awards over 1,000,000 FCFA to outstanding pupils in Mbengwi Central and is hosted at the Guneku Fon’s Palace.

editions.winners: Top scorer from Wumnebug, with two runners-up

editions.recipients: Class 6 pupils of P.S. Mbengwi Annex Guneku
editions.note: Awarded for performance in the 2022 Common Entrance and First School Leaving Certificate examinations.
